about_the_game:
About this Game:

Welcome to Rose Academy for the Gifted where the best and brightest graduate standing on top of the world! Take on the role of George, a transfer student, in his final year at high school. Help George through the ups and downs of his high school social life as he works to make friends while campaigning against Richard, the most popular kid in school and his roommate. Learn about the other students, understand what they're really trying to say, and earn their trust as fast as possible in order to win the title of Prom king in this Shakespeare inspired social simulation game!

Are you confident you can earn the crown in time?

Features

  • Converse with students! - Talk to the popular kids in the school to earn their trust and help them trust each other!

  • Reveal what they're really saying! - Intuit what these students are really trying to say and understand exactly what they want to hear!

  • Snapshot information! - Take mental snapshots of character information and use them as dialogue choices to earn more trust!

  • Explore the school - Choose a location each week, increase your grades, and find characters throughout the academy to talk to!

short_description: Welcome to Rose Academy, home to the brightest students in the world! Play as the new transfer student, George, as he embarks on his campaign against Richard, the most popular kid in school. Develop friendships, master your grades, and talk your way to earning the title of Prom King!
